* Damage is based on user's PWR
* Power of the move changes at random (2.5x/3x/3.5x/4x/5x)
* When not in Another Force: Consumes 1 Material to increase damage at random (5x/6x/7x/8x/9x/10x) and Attack again at no extra MP cost
** Counts as a separate move, so will increase Another Force gauge again
* When Defense Wall is deployed: Skill Multiplier +900% (Multiplier x10)

skills.name: Dimension Bomb - EOT
lines: Fire type magic attack on all enemies with Dimension Bomb stacked (XL) and guaranteed critical and Slash resistance -90% and Magic resistance -90% (2 turns)
* Damage is based on user's PWR
* Multiplier increases based on number of Dimension Bombs stacked (Max Multiplier x20):
* If there are no Dimension Bomb stacks, nothing happens.
* If there is at least 1 enemy with a Dimension Bomb stack, then for any enemies without Dimension Bombs, the multiplier will be 150%.
* All Dimension Bombs are consumed by this attack.
